description: This file defines classes, enums, and interfaces related to fault injection control within Orleans transactions. It includes mechanisms to inject faults at different phases and types during transaction processing for testing purposes.

classes.name: FaultInjectionControl
classes.description: Class encapsulating fault injection phase and type for a transaction, with a method to reset to default state.

classes.name: TransactionFaultInjectPhase
classes.description: Enum representing different phases at which faults can be injected during a transaction's lifecycle.

classes.name: FaultInjectionType
classes.description: Enum representing types of fault injections such as exceptions or deactivation.

classes.name: IFaultInjectionTransactionalState<TState>
classes.description: Interface extending ITransactionalState with fault injection control property.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalState<TState>
classes.description: Implementation of the fault injection transactional state, managing fault injection controls, participation in lifecycle, and resource factory setup.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the FaultInjectionControl's fault injection phase and type to 'None'.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the fault injection transactional state to the grain lifecycle for setup.

methods.name: SetupResourceFactory
methods.description: Sets up resource factories for fault injection resources and transaction managers within the grain context.

methods.name: PerformRead
methods.description: Performs a read operation on the transactional state.

methods.name: PerformUpdate
methods.description: Performs an update operation on the transactional state.
